correctness.rationale: Every induced matching is uniquely enumerated by increasing edge index in the 27-vertex conflict graph; the exact levels (1,27,189,387,135,27,0) prove the size-five optimum and the 27 optima. All 549 reserve-three states and 675 transitions are exhaustively reconstructed, with 396+153 components. All 27 optimum BFS traversals produce the exact fourfold metric and distance histogram, and a 27-entry explicit permutation is checked against every adjacency in the line graph of Pappus. A structurally separate LCF/combinations implementation independently reproduces all finite conclusions and the graph isomorphism. Claims are finite and have no extrapolation.

value.rationale: The induced-matching problem is motivated by distance-separated edge packing and strong edge coloring; optimum size alone does not indicate whether optimal allocations can be transformed without losing packing feasibility. The sharp one-vs-two deleted-edge reserve, the 27-star obstruction, and the exact line-graph compressed metric provide substantive reconfiguration structure with plausible use as a small symmetric benchmark, not an arbitrary small numerical gain.
